title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
Drive operational excellence & branch performance across unsecured lending
Translate executive strategy into measurable plans, KPIs, & business growth
Build organisational capability through hands-on leadership, coaching
Job Overview
A prominent finance and lending institution in Papua New Guinea is seeking a hands-on, strategic Chief Operating Officer (COO) to oversee operations, drive growth in unsecured lending, and lead branch and support teams. This is a high-impact role for a results-driven executive who excels in operational execution, revenue growth, and building high-performing teams.
Key Responsibilities:
Serve as the CEO’s primary operational and strategic partner, translating enterprise strategy into actionable plans and measurable KPIs.
Drive performance across branches, back-office teams, and lending operations, ensuring high-quality service, process adherence, and operational compliance.
Lead unsecured lending operations, including personal loans and payroll-based lending, with a focus on government payroll and key client relationships.
Participate in executive and board discussions, contributing to enterprise strategy, business plans, and major transformation initiatives.
Oversee complex operational projects, including automation, pricing reforms, product transitions, and process improvements, ensuring they are embedded into daily operations.
Build organisational capability through coaching, mentoring, and talent development, including succession planning for operational leadership roles.
Monitor performance metrics, including loan growth, arrears reduction, cost-to-income, non-interest income, customer satisfaction, and project delivery.
Act as the operational bridge between CEO, branches, and key clients, resolving high-level customer issues and supporting business development.
Lead operational response during crises and act as CEO in their absence, ensuring continuity and decisive decision-making.
Candidate Profile:
Proven leadership in banking, finance, or insurance, with 10+ years hands-on operational experience managing branch networks, back-office teams, and sales operations.
Strong record of executing complex initiatives, embedding operational discipline, and delivering measurable results.
Tertiary qualification in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business/Commerce; postgraduate qualifications advantageous.
Exceptional personal integrity, practical communication, financial judgment, and cultural adaptability, with a deep understanding of the PNG business environment.
Calm, decisive, and results-focused under pressure.
Why Join:
This is a
high-profile executive role
offering the opportunity to shape operations, drive growth, and make a tangible impact in a leading finance and lending institution in PNG.
